metadata.repo_type_justification: Application source code (Ruby/Rails controller) with a deployable entry point (Rails application serving HTTP) and database-backed CRUD operations present. README describes active EC2 deployment. Classified as application.
metadata.archetype_justification: MySQL database with Order ActiveRecord model, create/update endpoints, and user-specific order data with payment processing. Classified as stateful-crud.

classification_consistency_check.reason: Score 1.18 yields Not Ready band but 11 High findings (< 12 threshold) yields Remediation Required tier. The systemic depth of gaps drives overall score below 1.5 while the count remains below the 12-High Not Ready threshold.

decomposition_strategy.rationale: The monolith is on EOL stack (Ruby 1.8.7, Rails 2.3) making in-place modularization unviable. Strangler Fig or full re-platform recommended.

approaches.name: Strengthen as Modular Monolith
approaches.reason: Underlying stack is EOL with unfetchable gems

approaches.name: Strangler Fig (Parallel Track)
approaches.reason: Build new services alongside existing monolith, migrate features incrementally

approaches.name: Conditional / Adaptive
approaches.reason: Re-platform to modern stack first, then selectively extract

approaches.name: Big-Bang Rewrite
approaches.reason: Consider only because existing stack is unmaintainable — high risk

findings.title: No managed compute — all workloads on raw EC2
findings.description: All compute runs on raw EC2 instances with Mongrel behind Apache mod_proxy_balancer. No managed container orchestration or serverless services.
findings.gap: No managed compute services in use. All compute requires manual provisioning, patching, and scaling.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to managed compute (ECS with Fargate or EKS) after containerizing the application. Requires Ruby/Rails stack upgrade as prerequisite.

findings.title: Self-managed MySQL 5.1 on EC2
findings.description: MySQL 5.1 runs self-managed on a separate EC2 instance. No managed database service is in use.
findings.gap: Database is entirely self-managed — manual patching, backup, failover, and scaling required.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to Amazon RDS MySQL or Aurora MySQL. Standard SQL without stored procedures makes DMS migration feasible.

findings.title: No workflow orchestration for order-payment flow
findings.description: The order creation workflow (create → charge card) is hardcoded in the controller with no orchestration, retry, or error handling.
findings.gap: No orchestration — workflow logic hardcoded with no retry or state management.
findings.recommendation: Adopt AWS Step Functions for the order-payment workflow to provide retry logic and error handling.

findings.title: No async messaging — synchronous payment processing
findings.description: No messaging infrastructure exists. Payment gateway is called synchronously within the HTTP request. No event-driven patterns for state changes.
findings.gap: No messaging where state changes should propagate asynchronously — tight synchronous coupling.
findings.recommendation: Introduce SQS or EventBridge for order state change events. Decouple payment processing from the HTTP request.

findings.title: No network security configuration
findings.description: No VPC, subnet, security group, or NACL configuration exists. No HTTPS termination at application tier.
findings.gap: No evidence of network security controls. HTTPS termination explicitly missing.
findings.recommendation: Define infrastructure in IaC with proper VPC, private subnets, security groups, and TLS termination.

findings.title: No managed API entry point
findings.description: No API Gateway, ALB, or CloudFront defined. Basic Apache reverse proxy described in README but not configured in repo.
findings.gap: No managed entry point with throttling, authentication, or request validation.
findings.recommendation: Implement API Gateway or ALB with WAF for request validation and throttling.

findings.title: No auto-scaling — static capacity
findings.description: No auto-scaling configured. Application deploys to a fixed set of EC2 hosts with statically provisioned capacity.
findings.gap: All capacity statically provisioned — no auto-scaling for compute or database.
findings.recommendation: Implement auto-scaling as part of compute modernization (ECS/EKS target-tracking policies).

findings.title: No backup or recovery configuration
findings.description: No backup configuration for MySQL database on EC2. No retention policy, no restore procedures.
findings.gap: No automated backup configuration for any data store.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to RDS/Aurora for automated backups, or implement AWS Backup for EC2-hosted MySQL.

findings.title: Zero Infrastructure as Code coverage
findings.description: No IaC exists. No Terraform, CloudFormation, CDK, or Helm. All infrastructure manually created.
findings.gap: 0% IaC coverage — all infrastructure is ClickOps, non-reproducible, non-auditable.
findings.recommendation: Adopt Terraform or CDK to codify target-state architecture (VPC, compute, database).

findings.title: No CI/CD automation — manual deployments
findings.description: No CI/CD pipeline exists. Deployment is manual via Capistrano 2 to fixed EC2 hosts.
findings.gap: No CI/CD automation — all deployments manual with no automated build, test, or deploy.
findings.recommendation: Implement CI/CD pipeline (CodePipeline + CodeBuild or GitHub Actions) with automated stages.

findings.title: EOL language and framework — Ruby 1.8.7 / Rails 2.3
findings.description: Ruby 1.8.7 (EOL 2013) with Rails 2.3 (EOL 2013). Gems pinned in environment.rb without Bundler.
findings.gap: Compound legacy: language version, framework, and dependency management all deeply regressed.
findings.recommendation: Upgrade to Ruby 3.2+ with Rails 7.x, or rewrite in a cloud-native language (TypeScript, Go, Python).

findings.title: Tightly-coupled monolith with no module boundaries
findings.description: Single deployable unit with no separation of concerns. Controller handles order CRUD, payment processing, and raw SQL all in one place.
findings.gap: Tightly-coupled monolith with pervasive shared state — no module boundaries, no architectural separation.
findings.recommendation: See Decomposition Strategy. Strangler Fig or re-platform approach recommended given EOL stack.

findings.title: All communication synchronous with no async patterns
findings.description: All communication is synchronous HTTP. Payment gateway blocks HTTP request thread. No async patterns.
findings.gap: All communication synchronous — payment gateway latency directly impacts user response time.
findings.recommendation: Introduce async processing for payment operations (SQS + worker) and order notifications.

findings.title: Long-running payment call handled synchronously
findings.description: External SOAP gateway call made synchronously within HTTP request. No timeout, no async job, no status polling.
findings.gap: External payment gateway call handled synchronously with no timeout or async pattern.
findings.recommendation: Move payment to async job (SQS worker or Step Functions) with status polling pattern.

findings.title: No API versioning strategy
findings.description: No API versioning. No version prefix, no version headers, no backward compatibility mechanism.
findings.gap: No versioning — breaking changes deployed directly with no consumer migration path.
findings.recommendation: Implement URL-based versioning (/v1/orders) when rebuilding the API layer.

findings.title: All service endpoints hardcoded
findings.description: Payment gateway endpoint hardcoded in config/payment.yml. No service discovery or dynamic routing.
findings.gap: All service endpoints hardcoded in configuration files checked into source control.
findings.recommendation: Externalize configuration using environment variables or AWS SSM Parameter Store.

findings.title: No managed object storage — assets served from app
findings.description: No S3 or managed object storage. Static assets served directly from application server with no CDN.
findings.gap: Data on local file systems with no managed storage or CDN.
findings.recommendation: Migrate static assets to S3 with CloudFront CDN.

findings.title: Database access scattered in controllers with no pattern
findings.description: Mix of ActiveRecord and raw SQL (find_by_sql with string interpolation) directly in controllers. No repository/DAO pattern.
findings.gap: Database queries scattered across controllers with no abstraction layer.
findings.recommendation: Implement repository or service layer pattern. Eliminate raw SQL in controllers.

findings.title: MySQL 5.1 past end-of-life (EOL December 2018)
findings.description: MySQL 5.1 in use per README. EOL December 2018 with known unpatched CVEs. No version pinning in IaC (no IaC exists).
findings.gap: Database engine past EOL with no version management or upgrade path.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to RDS MySQL 8.0+ or Aurora MySQL 3.x.

findings.title: No encryption at rest for sensitive data
findings.description: No encryption at rest configured. MySQL on EC2 stores card numbers with no disk encryption or KMS.
findings.gap: No encryption at rest for sensitive data including payment card information.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to RDS/Aurora with KMS encryption. Adopt tokenization for card data.

findings.title: No API authentication on endpoints
findings.description: No authentication. Controller comment states 'No before_filter auth on some actions (legacy oversight).'
findings.gap: No API authentication — endpoints are open.
findings.recommendation: Implement authentication using Cognito or external IdP with JWT/OAuth2.

findings.title: No centralized identity integration
findings.description: No IdP integration. Cookie-based sessions with secret in source control.
findings.gap: Application manages its own authentication with no external IdP.
findings.recommendation: Integrate with Amazon Cognito or Okta for centralized identity.

findings.title: Plaintext credentials committed to source control
findings.description: Payment gateway credentials (merchant_id, api_password) in plaintext in config/payment.yml. Session secret also in source control.
findings.gap: Plaintext credentials in version-controlled configuration — critical security vulnerability.
findings.recommendation: Rotate credentials immediately. Migrate to AWS Secrets Manager with rotation. Purge from git history.

findings.title: No compute hardening or patching strategy
findings.description: No patching strategy. EC2 runs EOL software with known CVEs. No SSM, no Inspector, no Dependabot.
findings.gap: No patching strategy — compute runs EOL software with known vulnerabilities.
findings.recommendation: Implement SSM Patch Manager and vulnerability scanning (Inspector or Snyk).

findings.title: No application security pipeline
findings.description: No security scanning tools. No CI/CD pipeline to integrate scanning. Known SQL injection exists undetected.
findings.gap: No security scanning — no SAST, no dependency scanning, no container scanning.
findings.recommendation: Implement CI/CD first, then add SAST (Semgrep) and dependency scanning (Dependabot/Snyk).

findings.title: No distributed tracing
findings.description: No X-Ray, no OpenTelemetry, no trace ID propagation on external calls.
findings.gap: No distributed tracing — debugging cross-service failures requires log correlation.
findings.recommendation: Instrument with OpenTelemetry or X-Ray when rebuilding the application.

findings.title: No SLO definitions
findings.description: No SLOs defined. No monitoring artifacts, no CloudWatch alarms, no latency targets.
findings.gap: No SLOs — no formal definition of acceptable service levels.
findings.recommendation: Define SLOs for critical user journeys (order placement, checkout latency).

findings.title: No business metrics instrumented
findings.description: No custom business metrics. No order count, conversion, or payment success rate tracking.
findings.gap: No business metrics — cannot measure order conversion or payment success rates.
findings.recommendation: Instrument business metrics (orders, payment success/failure, order value) with CloudWatch.

findings.title: No anomaly detection or alerting
findings.description: No CloudWatch alarms, no anomaly detection, no on-call integration. Failures discovered only when reported.
findings.gap: No alerting configured — failures discovered only reactively.
findings.recommendation: Implement CloudWatch alarms on error rates and latency. Integrate with PagerDuty/OpsGenie.

findings.title: No automated tests — stale test suite
findings.description: No working tests. README states tests are stale and no longer run. No test files in repo.
findings.gap: No automated tests — no safety net for changes, migrations, or deployments.
findings.recommendation: Build integration test suite for critical workflows as prerequisite for modernization.

findings.title: No observability ownership
findings.description: No dashboards, no alarms with owners, no CODEOWNERS for monitoring. Monitoring entirely absent.
findings.gap: No observability ownership — monitoring is non-existent.
findings.recommendation: Define per-service dashboards and alarms with named owners when implementing observability.
